migration_and_rollback.projection_note: The change is confined to the existing compile_relation_blocks owner and its existing retention regression owner. Reverting the production and test commits restores the prior eager-hash behavior without changing any authority contract or rewriting history.

title: Prune empty same-plane Fourfold retention before Forest hashing

masterplan.active_delivery_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

result.summary: The canonical multi-relation compiler now prunes a same-plane ForestEdge before canonical hashing when its bound Fourfold plane retained no relation digests at all. This applies to an explicitly selected matching relation and to discover-all. Semantic output is unchanged: explicit selection still yields the same empty closed-world block, while discover-all still discovers no unretained row.
result.structural_change: Avoid canonical_sha(edge.to_dict()) when retained_relation_digests[source_plane] is empty after the existing selected-signature prune.
result.gardener: The bounded target from GPU-60 was implemented directly in the existing compiler owner. No helper, cache, adapter, projection authority, registry, backend, fact store, public API or duplicate test module was added.

implementation.test_strategy: The two existing empty-retention regressions now monkeypatch relation_compiler.canonical_sha to fail on any attempted relation hash; existing evidence-materialization guards and retained-row equivalence tests remain in the same test owner.

preserved_boundaries: GPU-56 exact verified Fourfold authority for cross-plane rows
GPU-59 retained/unretained same-plane Boolean projection equivalence
Forest/Fourfold provenance-revision and global partition validation

claim_boundaries.correctness: Claimed only for the tested empty-retention pre-hash prune and the already-covered adjacent Fourfold/Tensor contract surface.
claim_boundaries.performance: No benchmark claim. The packet proves structurally avoided canonical hashing when the same-plane retention set is empty; it does not claim a measured latency improvement.
claim_boundaries.diagnostics: CPU bitset and TypedRelationBlock profiles remain diagnostic-only with claim=none.
